title: Free Time
text:
I like to have free time on the weekend. On Saturday I play football with my friends. We play in the park near my house. After that, we eat ice cream.

On Sunday I read books in my room. I like stories about animals. My sister likes to paint pictures. She paints flowers and trees.

questions.text: What does the writer play on Saturday?
What does the writer do on Sunday?
How does the writer feel about spending time with friends?
What can you infer about the writer's sister?

vocabulary.definition: a sport played with a round ball and two teams
a public green area where people can play and relax
books or texts that describe imaginary or real events

paragraph_translations: Me gusta tener tiempo libre los fines de semana. El sábado juego al fútbol con mis amigos. Jugamos en el parque cerca de mi casa. Después, comemos helado.
El domingo leo libros en mi habitación. Me gustan las historias sobre animales. A mi hermana le gusta pintar cuadros. Ella pinta flores y árboles.
